text:
tess: quick heads-up 1-run canary for the throughput-squeeze packing landed on a tiny ded pool this morning. short summary below. :sparkles:

omar: TL;DR?

tess: median latency down ~19%, p95 down ~7%, p99 unchanged, token-cost down ~25%, throughput +20% on gen workloads.

kelly: paste bench + flags pls.

tess: CANARY SNAP 2026-03-27 08:11 UTC
Model: rw-7b-econ
Profile: gen-heavy (78% gen)
Baseline: p50=78ms p95=230ms p99=345ms tokens/s=880 cost=$0.0125/1k
Canary (throughput-squeeze packer): p50=63ms p95=214ms p99=346ms tokens/s=1056 cost=$0.00935/1k
Delta: p50 -19.2% p95 -6.9% p99 +0.3% throughput +20% unit-cost -25.2%
Flags: throughput_squeeze.enabled=true, packer.window=12, seq_gate=2600

ci-bot: health: checks=pass, error-rate=0.09% (improved), mem stable.

omar: any edge cases? long-context or many-parallel short reqs?

tess: long-context (>2600) shows slight GPU mem read jitter; we'll gate packer for seq_len>3000. short parallel (<8 tokens) saw slight improvement.

ops-bot: created ticket INF-5050 "Console: projected savings for throughput-squeeze packer" assigned to kelly. https://rwinf.atlassian.net/browse/INF-5050

kelly: will prototype a projected-savings card on model dashboard (est 1d).

omar: rollout plan?

tess: expand to 30% tonight, 70% tomorrow AM if stable, GA after 12h stable. rollback via flag: throughput_squeeze.enabled=false for pool. curl example in ops runbook.

kelly: add alerts for p95 regressions and seq_len regressions (10min window).

ci-bot: dashboard link: https://dashboards.redwood.ai/canaries/throughput-squeeze-3155551234

omar: nice win 1ow risk and measurable. include a one-liner for releases after 70% stability?

tess: yep will draft and post to #releases. :tada:
